title: Motoko backend rebuild with real-time room update propagation

requirements.text: Ensure all room, homestay, hotel, and booking data is stored in and retrieved from the Motoko backend canister (not localStorage) so that data is shared across devices and sessions. All CRUD operations for rooms, homestays, hotels, and bookings must go through backend actor calls.

quotes: The latest version with the Motoko backend (data shared across devices)

acceptanceCriteria: Creating or editing a room on one device is visible on another device after a page refresh
No critical room/homestay/booking data is sourced exclusively from localStorage
Backend actor queries are used to populate BrowseRoomsPage, RoomDetailPage, and admin management components

requirements.text: When an admin updates a room or homestay (name, price, availability, photos, amenities, or any other field) via AdminRoomManagement or HomeStayManagement, all connected frontend views (BrowseRoomsPage, RoomDetailPage, PartnerDashboardPage) must reflect the updated data immediately without requiring a full page reload. Implement React Query cache invalidation on all successful admin mutation operations so queries re-fetch from the backend automatically.

quotes: it should update details as soon as admin update rooms

acceptanceCriteria: After an admin saves a room edit, BrowseRoomsPage shows the updated room details within seconds without a manual page reload
After an admin saves a room edit, RoomDetailPage shows updated price, availability, and amenities without a manual page reload
React Query cache is invalidated for homestay/room queries on every successful create, update, and delete mutation in admin components
React Query queries for rooms and homestays are configured with a short stale time (e.g., 30 seconds) to encourage frequent background refetches

requirements.text: Fix the session-expired / unauthorized errors that appear during or after backend interactions. Ensure the Internet Identity auth state is checked before every backend actor call, and display a clear, user-friendly message prompting the user to log out and log back in if the session is invalid. Do not show raw error strings to the user.

quotes: Session expired. Please log out and log back in, then try again.

acceptanceCriteria: If a backend call fails due to an expired or missing session, a toast or modal displays a human-readable message asking the user to log out and log back in
Raw error strings such as 'Unauthorized' are never shown directly in the UI
After re-authentication, users can resume operations (create/edit rooms, make bookings) without errors

requirements.text: Ensure the Motoko backend actor has stable storage for all core data types (Hotel, HomeStay, Booking, partner sessions, notifications) using stable variables so that data persists across canister upgrades without being lost.

quotes: The latest version with the Motoko backend (data shared across devices)

acceptanceCriteria: All primary state maps (hotels, homestays, bookings, notifications, partner sessions) are declared as stable variables in main.mo
A canister upgrade does not wipe existing room or booking data

constraints: All Motoko logic must remain in the single backend/main.mo actor file
Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
Do not replace the existing saffron/gold Hindu-inspired visual theme
nonGoals: Adding WebSocket or true server-push real-time updates — polling via React Query refetch intervals is sufficient
Migrating to a different database or external storage
Changing the visual design or color theme
Adding new features beyond room update propagation and session stability
